text: DEFONEOS — DWP Pension Protection Fund AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × PENSION PROTECTION FUND DWP Pension Protection Fund AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK DWP Pension Protection Fund: pension scheme assessment, compensation calculation, member protection, insolvency proceedings. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. UK-sovereign, audit-grade, AUKUS-compatible. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points PPF Eligibility Pension Protection Fund Eligibility AI Scheme assessment for PPF entry. Eligible scheme criteria. Tranche determination. Section 126 valuation. Employer insolvency trigger. Moratorium period. Scheme funding status. Compensation Calculation PPF Compensation AI Compensation cap calculation (current £41,389 pa). 90% compensation for below-cap members. Revaluation methodology. Annual increase rules. Lump sum conversion. Dependant benefits. Scheme Transfer PPF Scheme Transfer AI Transfer value assessment. Augmentation rules. Buy-out pricing. Enhanced transfer values. Individual transfer calculations. SIPP transfer guidance. Deadline management. Member Protection PPF Member Protection AI Member notification automation. Benefit statement generation. Retirement option guidance. Ill-health early retirement. Dependant benefit claims. Address tracing. Insolvency Proceedings PPF Insolvency AI Employer insolvency detection. Notifiable events monitoring. Scheme apportionment. Section 75 debt. Financial Support Direction. Contribution Notice. Fraud Prevention PPF Fraud Detection AI Scheme fraud monitoring. Pension liberation detection. Contribution evasion. False claims. Identity verification. Cross-scheme pattern matching. Investment Governance PPF Investment Oversight AI Investment strategy monitoring. Risk exposure analysis. De-risking triggers. Buy-in/buy-out tracking. Asset allocation compliance. Performance attribution. Actuarial Assessment PPF Actuarial AI Scheme funding level estimation. Mortality assumptions. Discount rate analysis. Stress testing. Recovery plan assessment. Technical provisions review. Digital Services PPF Digital Platform AI Member portal automation. Online claim submission. Document upload processing. Chatbot integration. Status tracking. Digital correspondence. Cross-Scheme PPF Cross-Scheme Intelligence AI Multi-scheme pattern analysis. Employer covenant assessment. Connected employer detection. Group scheme relationships. Risk concentration alert. Data PPF Data Governance AI Scheme data quality audit. Member record reconciliation. Benefit data cleansing. Historical data migration. Data retention compliance. GDPR alignment. Parliamentary PPF Parliamentary AI PPF levy statistics. Compensation expenditure metrics. Member outcome reporting. Policy reform modelling. Select Committee evidence. International benchmarking. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. Compassionate Member Contact Trauma-informed PPF contact for members entering PPF protection. No cold calling within 14 days of scheme transfer notification. Single point of contact. Pension-loss-sensitive communications. 2. Full Compensation Protection No PPF member left worse off than their accrued scheme benefits where possible. 90% floor maintained. Cap indexed to inflation. Dependant benefits preserved. 3. Digital-First Scheme Assessment Automated scheme eligibility determination. Real-time funding level monitoring. Predictive insolvency detection. 48-hour benefit statement generation. 4. Fraud Zero-Tolerance Pension liberation detected within 72 hours. Contribution evasion flagged automatically. Cross-scheme fraud intelligence sharing. HMRC/Pension Regulator integration. 5. Buy-Out Acceleration Target: 80% of PPF eligible schemes achieving buy-out within 10 years. Enhanced transfer value programmes. Insurance market engagement. 6. Retirement Option Optimisation A
